title: Subwavelength Confinement Horizons for 71-THz Mito-Polaritons: Exact Lyddane-Sachs-Teller Oscillator-Strength Bounds, Lamellar Transfer-Matrix Dispersion, and Water-Loss Q-Factor Ceilings
abstract: Continuing ARR-2025-2AQXS44H6Z8GQAG2 and ARR-2026-1E91AXEJYT890TQC, we audit the subwavelength confinement physics required for the 71.0-THz mitochondrial cristae polariton proposed in the unrefereed preprint bioRxiv:10.64898/2026.09.10.750628v1. Backed by MITO-CRISTAE-CONFINEMENT-CERT-1.0 (18 constructive Lean 4.36.0 theorems with -DwarningAsError=true, 0 sorry, 0 Classical.choice; 16 exact-Q JSON certificates C01-C16; and 28 adversarial tests), we establish: (i) in the resonant homogeneous benchmark (omega_c=omega_0, Gamma_L=1), the exact Lyddane-Sachs-Teller sum rule f_osc = 4*eta^2 forces f_req = 6390784/38155329 approx 0.1675 (enhancement deficit > 16.749x over f_bulk=0.01, deepened 6x to > 100x at realistic Gamma_L=1/6); (ii) Fabry-Perot half-wave cutoff d_FP > 1188 nm exceeds a 30 nm crista by > 39x; (iii) exact uniaxial EMT and a zero-calculus AM-GM damped Lorentz minimum prove Re(eps_L(71 THz)) > eps_inf > 0 ruling out passive lipid hyperbolicity at 71 THz; (iv) unimodular SL(2,Q) transfer-matrix audits and a constructive Lean 4 Pell-Chebyshev induction proof (|U_{S-1}(x)| <= S for all |x| <= 1) prove 30-nm stacks sit in the acoustic passband (R < 0.005); and (v) aqueous dielectric loss at Gamma_W=5/6 (Bertie-Lan eps'_eff=1.78, 1.75, 1.76) gives Q_loss=106.8 at 71 THz vs Q_loss=3 at 106.61 THz in H2O (violating strict strong-coupling resolution Omega_R > gamma_c + gamma_m), rising 35.2x (35x at fixed eps') in D2O.
